intro.text: A Shin city near the Willshaper monastery, surrounded by grass-covered hills and farmland.

description.text: Its roughly two hundred buildings are brightly painted, with boardwalks and fixed awnings. Doors and windows use metal fittings.
Wooden palisades, a gate and a raised walkway form the city's improvised defenses.

items.text: People who resisted the corruption in neighboring settlements gathered in Koring. They farmed outside by day and sheltered behind its walls against nighttime attacks.
Szeth and Kaladin found the city resisting the influence affecting much of Shinovar. After visiting the monastery, Szeth returned to promise help to the gathered people.
